summary: The diff implements DisposableStack.prototype.move in its own file, in spec order. It runs RequireInternalSlot via require_disposable_stack, then the ReferenceError check on the disposed flag. It then calls ops::ordinary_create_from_constructor with %DisposableStack% and the "%DisposableStack.prototype%" intrinsic name, moves the resource stack with mem::take, sets the source to disposed, and returns the new object. Every abstract step is propagated with `?`, and each spec step is kept as a comment above its code. The only changes outside the stub's steps are renaming the unused parameters to `_args` and `_new_target`, and dropping the not-implemented return. Nothing is special-cased, hardcoded, or swallowed. The four remaining failures come from the not-implemented DisposableStack.prototype.disposed getter, which belongs to another built-in and is an honest not-implemented throw.
